description: Recorded Starfold run on the scikit-learn digits dataset (notebooks/runs/digits at v0.2.0) with the notebook's 2-D display layout, for an interactive demo.
display_layout: umap.UMAP(n_neighbors, min_dist from deployed_params, n_components=2, random_state=0, n_jobs=1) on StandardScaler(X); the same call as notebooks/01_digits.ipynb; the axes have no meaning; recomputed 2026-10-25

fields.truth: true digit, never seen by Starfold
fields.default_labels: one fit of the UMAP and HDBSCAN defaults
fields.own_support: share of the refits that sampled the row in which it stayed with its group; -1 for the 30 unassigned rows, which have no group
fields.world_labels: labels in each of the 32 refits: -1 unassigned, -2 row not sampled in that refit; group ids are per refit and not aligned across refits
